script_text: Something sinister is hovering over your emotional world this week, Cancer. Your ruling Moon is currently square Mars in the 10th House of career, creating intense friction at work from Monday through Wednesday. This Water element feels overwhelmed by professional demands and unexpected financial pressure. However, a crucial shift occurs in the middle of the week as Venus enters your 7th House of partnerships. This transit transforms your love life with profound intimacy while soothing the professional stress. Your sensitive Water nature finds weekend comfort in close romantic relationships and domestic harmony. Thursday is your power day because Venus trines Pluto in your 7th House of love, but Monday is your worst day because Mars squares your natal Moon in the 10th House of career. You must set firm boundaries to protect your energy from manipulative coworkers and demanding bosses. Always follow for daily updates.
